title: Add contact delivery and legal pages
context: The portfolio needs a cookie-free, serverless contact form before its Vercel launch, plus accurate public legal pages and removal of the unused contact route.

tasks.title: Implement secure homepage contact delivery
acceptance_criteria: The homepage form validates name, email, and message accessibly, reports pending, success, and failure states, and links to the privacy policy.
POST /api/contact validates bounded input, silently suppresses honeypot submissions, sends a plain-text Resend email with the visitor address only as Reply-To, and exposes no provider details.
The contact route is removed, Resend environment variables are documented, and route/browser tests cover validation, success/failure, and honeypot behavior.

tasks.title: Address feedback on task 1: Stabilize contact-form errors and status treatments
acceptance_criteria: All invalid contact fields show their own accessible error without changing the form's normal layout.
Field errors and invalid fields use the shared error token; the message group retains no reserved error padding.
Delivery errors and success messages use distinct accessible surface treatments with Error and Success prefixes, without duplicating field-validation messages.

tasks.title: Address feedback on task 2: Correct reserved field-error space
acceptance_criteria: Name and email groups reserve a 1.5em error line whether or not an error is present.
The message group has no default reserved error space and gains a 1.5em error line only when invalid.
Browser coverage asserts the default and invalid padding behavior.

tasks.title: Address feedback on task 3: Move the contact field grid desktop breakpoint
acceptance_criteria: The contact field grid remains single-column below 62rem.
The contact field grid switches to two equal columns at 62rem and above.
Browser coverage asserts both sides of the 62rem boundary.

tasks.title: Publish accurate privacy and terms pages
acceptance_criteria: The privacy policy and terms content render as semantic static pages with accurate Vercel, Resend, no-analytics, and request-security disclosures.
The footer label is Terms of Service while its existing /terms-of-use URL remains valid.
Browser coverage verifies legal content and /contact returns 404.
